# optimizelycmssaas_content_type_binding (Data Source)

Looks up an existing content_type_binding by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_content_type_binding" "existing" {
  key = "ProductToPage"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the content_type_binding to look up.

### Read-Only

- `from` (String) Key of the content type bound from.
- `property_mappings` (Attributes Map) Property mappings. The map key is the path the property binds to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_mappings))
- `to` (String) Key of the content type bound to.

<a id="nestedatt--property_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `property_mappings`

Read-Only:

- `binding` (String) Key of an existing binding to reuse for this property.
- `from` (String) Path of the property on the source content type.
